subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: When orientation completes without a covering overlap, the skill shall present two to three genuinely distinct framings of the feature — each implying a different thesis of what it is — and shall record the operator's choice or hybrid as the session's destination.
rationale: first-idea anchoring is cheapest to counter before any deep grilling
fit_criterion: every gated fixture record contains ≥ 2 framings and one operator-chosen destination with rationale
